nodes.name: execution_bench.json
nodes.summary: Persisted benchmark artifact capturing execution policy replay results, byte-identity checks, fill-model fingerprints, and guard-block attribution for both real and synthetic sequences.

nodes.name: run_execution_bench.py
nodes.summary: Execution-layer benchmark runner that replays real and synthetic trading sequences through the guard/decision/fill chain, verifying byte-identical replay and producing a JSON artifact with coverage metrics.

nodes.name: _replay_block
nodes.summary: Runs two independent replay passes of a sequence through the execution chain, compares serialized outputs for byte-identity, and returns per-step comparison results.

nodes.name: _build_chain
nodes.summary: Constructs the full feature-extraction/classification/guard/decision/operational pipeline from a snapshot path, returning all component instances needed for replay.

nodes.name: run_real
nodes.summary: Iterates real snapshot data through the execution chain, collecting admitted feature values and running replay blocks to verify determinism against real market data.

nodes.name: run_synthetic
nodes.summary: Runs synthetic admit-decision sequences through execution replay, covering directional boundary combinations to verify guard-block attribution across controlled inputs.

nodes.name: build_report
nodes.summary: Assembles the full benchmark report dictionary by invoking real and synthetic runs, stamping policy fingerprints and schema versions, and computing aggregate metrics.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that calls build_report, writes the JSON artifact to disk, and prints a summary of byte-identity and replay metrics.

nodes.name: gold_bench.json
nodes.summary: Gold-layer benchmark artifact recording decision-policy determinism checks and synthetic confidence/uncertainty sweep results against real packet data.

nodes.name: paper_runtime_bench.json
nodes.summary: Paper-trading runtime benchmark artifact capturing ledger schema, real-sequence replay results, and synthetic packet round-trip determinism for the runtime policy.

nodes.name: run_gold_bench.py
nodes.summary: Gold-layer benchmark runner that verifies decision-policy determinism against real snapshot data and sweeps a Cartesian grid of synthetic feature vectors to characterise confidence/uncertainty coverage.

nodes.name: run_determinism
nodes.summary: Consumes real snapshot data twice, builds feature vectors, classifies regimes, and verifies that two independent build_decision calls produce byte-identical JSON for every input.

nodes.name: run_synthetic_sweep
nodes.summary: Sweeps a Cartesian product of feature-axis values over a predefined grid, computing decision confidence/uncertainty statistics and boundary coverage for the gold decision policy.

nodes.name: build_report
nodes.summary: Assembles the gold benchmark report dictionary with policy fingerprint and the results from determinism and synthetic sweep runs.

nodes.name: run_paper_runtime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Paper-trading runtime benchmark that replays real GoldDecisionPacket sequences through the ledger, verifies deterministic round-trips, and sweeps synthetic packet combinations for byte-identity validation.

nodes.name: _replay_block
nodes.summary: Executes two independent runtime-sequence replays, serialises ledger state, and verifies byte-identical output for each packet pair.

nodes.name: _build_real_item
nodes.summary: Constructs a GoldDecisionPacket and its operational input from a real snapshot path by consuming snapshot data, extracting features, classifying regime, and computing a decision.

nodes.name: run_real
nodes.summary: Builds real-data packet pairs from snapshot directories and runs deterministic replay blocks to validate ledger byte-identity on actual market data.

nodes.name: _synthetic_packet
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic GoldDecisionPacket with controlled snapshot guards and confidence inputs for a given direction and regime, enabling parametric replay testing.

nodes.name: run_synthetic
nodes.summary: Generates synthetic packet sets for all direction/regime boundary combinations and verifies replay byte-identity across the full synthetic parameter space.

nodes.name: build_report
nodes.summary: Assembles the paper-runtime benchmark report with policy fingerprint and real/synthetic run results.

nodes.name: regime_bench.json
nodes.summary: Regime-classifier benchmark artifact recording determinism results, entropy metrics across a synthetic feature grid, and decision fingerprints for all classifier versions.

nodes.name: run_regime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Regime-classifier benchmark runner that verifies classification determinism on real snapshots and sweeps a synthetic feature grid, computing entropy and coverage statistics.

nodes.name: run_determinism
nodes.summary: Consumes real snapshot data twice, builds feature vectors, and verifies that two independent classify calls produce byte-identical JSON for every input.

nodes.name: run_synthetic_sweep
nodes.summary: Sweeps a full Cartesian product of regime feature-axis values, computing per-class confidence, boundary coverage, entropy and mutual-information metrics for the classifier.

nodes.name: build_report
nodes.summary: Assembles the regime benchmark report with decision fingerprint and results from determinism and synthetic sweep runs.

nodes.name: Alpaca API Docs.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph api_doc_source node specifying the scope, retrieval method, authentication requirements, and usage constraints for the Alpaca trading API reference within the el_nino session context.

nodes.name: Anthropic API Docs.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph api_doc_source node specifying the scope, retrieval method, and usage constraints for the Anthropic Claude API reference used by JARVIS backend Claude integration.

nodes.name: Upgrade Evaluation.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph capability node describing the Upgrade Evaluation capability: evaluating model/library upgrades against benchmark regressions before adoption, with its inputs, outputs, and architectural constraints.

nodes.name: Context Pack Template.md
nodes.summary: Canonical template for assembling typed context packs used in Claude coding sessions, defining sections for canonical nodes, required files, tests, constraints, API docs, decisions, admissibility checks, and implementation/validation/writeback plans.

nodes.name: Phase 5 Bootstrap Context.md
nodes.summary: Instantiated context pack for Phase 5 bootstrap work: assembles canonical nodes, required files, constraints, API docs, and an implementation plan for bootstrapping the dev_graph substrate and producing ADR-003.

nodes.name: Dev Graph Dashboard.md
nodes.summary: Consolidated Obsidian Dataview dashboard providing live queries for node inventory, type/status distributions, orphan detection, stale-node alerts, constraint/test coverage gaps, benchmark inventory, and population-debt tracking across the dev_graph.

nodes.name: test_scoring.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph test node documenting the test_scoring test file: its definition, purpose, constraints, and dependency relationships within the scoring module verification chain.

nodes.name: System Lifecycle.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph workflow node defining the system lifecycle state machine (planned → active → deprecated) with transition guards, state definitions, and relationships to the constraints and knowledge assets that govern system evolution.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI backend for JARVIS providing read-only Neo4j graph exploration endpoints (health, meta, node, neighbors, search, shortest_path, subgraph), a GraphRAG /ask endpoint powered by Claude, and voice STT/TTS endpoints via Whisper and Piper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses FastAPI dependency-free lifespan for Neo4j driver lifecycle; all Cypher is read-only enforced at driver level and via a keyword guard function.

nodes.name: run_read
nodes.summary: Thin Neo4j session wrapper that passes Cypher through the guard, opens a read session, executes the query, and returns rows as a list of dicts.

nodes.name: _graph
nodes.summary: Converts raw Neo4j record lists into a deduplicated graph response dict with nodes and edges, accepting flexible column naming for node keys and path keys.

nodes.name: neighbors
nodes.summary: API endpoint that returns the neighborhood graph for a node at a given depth and direction, falling back to the node itself when no neighbors are found.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Full-text search endpoint querying node canonical_id, name, and summary fields by case-insensitive substring match with optional label filtering.

nodes.name: shortest_path
nodes.summary: API endpoint computing the shortest path between two nodes via Cypher shortestPath, returning the path as a subgraph.

nodes.name: _score
nodes.summary: Relevance scorer for the GraphRAG ask pipeline that computes token-overlap and ID-prefix scores against a query normalised string.

nodes.name: _neighborhood
nodes.summary: Expands a seed node to its 1-hop neighborhood from both live Neo4j and the static graph.json, merging unique nodes for the GraphRAG context block.

nodes.name: _claude_answer
nodes.summary: Calls the Anthropic Messages API with a graph-derived context block to generate a grounded answer, returning the text response or raising an HTTPException on API failure.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: GraphRAG question-answering endpoint that matches a question to seed nodes, expands their neighborhood, builds a context block, and returns a Claude-generated answer with cited canonical IDs.

nodes.name: voice_stt
nodes.summary: Speech-to-text endpoint that accepts an audio upload, transcribes it using faster-whisper, and returns the transcript text.

nodes.name: voice_tts
nodes.summary: Text-to-speech endpoint that pipes input text through the Piper TTS binary, writes WAV output to a temp file, and returns the audio bytes as a response.

nodes.name: Health
nodes.summary: Pydantic response model for the /health endpoint capturing Neo4j connectivity, node/edge counts, and an optional error detail string.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency manifest for the JARVIS FastAPI backend listing runtime packages: FastAPI, uvicorn, neo4j driver, anthropic SDK, faster-whisper, and related libraries.

nodes.name: export_graph_json.py
nodes.summary: CLI tool that scans the dev_graph markdown, extracts node properties and relationship edges via sync_to_neo4j helpers, and writes a graph.json projection consumed by the JARVIS HUD and backend /ask corpus.

nodes.name: first_sentence_of_definition
nodes.summary: Extracts the first sentence of the Definition section from a markdown node's body, stripping wikilinks and collapsing whitespace, with a fallback string for nodes lacking a definition.

nodes.name: build_graph
nodes.summary: Scans the dev_graph, parses each node's frontmatter and relationships, resolves wikilink targets to canonical IDs, and returns sorted node/edge lists plus a skip log for unresolvable references.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that parses output-path arguments, invokes build_graph, serialises the result as JSON, and writes to stdout or the specified file paths (both frontend and hud paths).

nodes.name: install.sh
nodes.summary: Shell installer script that copies the pre-commit hook into the .git/hooks directory and makes it executable.

nodes.name: pre-commit
nodes.summary: Git pre-commit hook that blocks commits when staged dev_graph markdown changes leave either graph.json projection stale, by regenerating the projection in-process and comparing it against the staged blob.

nodes.name: graph.json
nodes.summary: Static server-less graph projection (nodes + edges) derived from dev_graph markdown, consumed by the JARVIS React HUD for offline and live graph exploration and by the backend /ask corpus seed matcher.

nodes.name: theme.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS design-token and theming file for the JARVIS HUD React application, defining color palette custom properties, typography, component variants, and layout primitives.

nodes.name: vite-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Vite client type declaration file that provides TypeScript ambient type definitions for Vite's import.meta.env and other client-side globals.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for the JARVIS HUD React application, setting up the React plugin and defining the dev-server proxy to the FastAPI backend.
